# payments-demo agent instructions

## Global rules

- [PAY-001] Payment creation must be idempotent: a repeated request with the same key returns the original payment and never charges twice. (global)
- [PAY-002] Validate currency and positive amount before calling the provider; return a typed error for invalid input. (global)
- [PAY-003] Keep provider-specific code in `internal/provider`; the application service depends on the `PaymentProvider` interface. (global)
